item.title: Socio-psychological Core
item.lead: This concluding page summarizes the editorial line without presenting the source claims as independently proven facts.

items: The dossier views trust as the central societal resource that can be weakened by commodification.
The "customer service" metaphor describes potential conditioning of both buyer and seller.
The gender and demographic claims are research breakthroughs within the dossier, but require independent empirical verification.
The recovery perspective revolves around autonomy, analogous social space, and unpaid human attention.

blocks.label: SOURCE STATUS
blocks.text: Based on the sections concerning social cohesion, the culture of danger, the customer service syndrome, demographic implosion, neurobiological rewiring, and post-digital recovery strategies. This Research Edition 4.0 adds current public source control as of September 19, 2026, and explicitly marks which figures/claims from the source material have not been independently verified.

Reader's guide for further research. The source itself mentions legal documentation, technical data, and sociological analysis as three tracks for triangulation. In this edition, these tracks have been brought together as an editorial structure; they have not been externally verified.
